message.reasoning:
We need to generate a test file NodeTest.java with JUnit 4. We must list public methods signatures. Then create basic tests, identify edge cases, generate tests for those, and produce final file wrapped with markers.

We need to test Node class, but it's abstract. We'll need a concrete subclass for testing. Could use a minimal subclass extending Node, implementing abstract methods: nodeName, hasAttributes, attributes, baseUri, doSetBaseUri, ensureChildNodes, childNodeSize, outerHtmlHead, outerHtmlTail. Also maybe getDeepChild uses Element etc but we can ignore.

Simplify: create a TestNode subclass inside test file.

Implement attributes using Attributes class (which is part of jsoup). We can create an Attributes object.

Implement child node list using ArrayList<Node>. Ensure childNodeSize returns list size.

Implement outerHtmlHead/Tail to write simple representation.

Implement baseUri tracking.

Implement nodeName returns "testnode".

Implement hasAttributes return true if attributes not empty.

Implement doSetBaseUri sets field.

Implement ensureChildNodes returns list.

Implement childNodeSize returns list.size.

Implement outerHtmlHead appends something.

We can test attr, hasAttr, removeAttr, clearAttributes, setBaseUri, absUrl, childNode, childNodes, childNodesCopy (deep copy), sibling navigation, replaceWith, before/after with HTML – but those rely on Parser and Element classes. Hard to test without full jsoup environment; but we can test simpler methods that do not require parsing.

Focus on attr, hasAttr, removeAttr, clearAttributes, setBaseUri (traversal will call doSetBaseUri on this and descendants). Since we have children list, we can test that setBaseUri updates baseUri of child nodes.

Test childNode (valid index) and out-of-bounds exception.

Test siblingNodes, nextSibling, previousSibling after building a parent with children.

Test replaceWith.

Test clone and shallowClone.

Edge cases: null arguments to attr, hasAttr, removeAttr etc – they use Validate.notNull which throws IllegalArgumentException? Actually Validate.notNull throws IllegalArgumentException. So test that passing null throws IllegalArgumentException.

Test absUrl with attribute not present returns empty.

Test absUrl with relative URL resolved – we need StringUtil.resolve; that resolves relative to baseUri. Use simple base "http://example.com/" and attribute "path" value "page.html". Ensure absUrl returns "http://example.com/page.html". Our TestNode's attr method returns attribute value; absUrl uses attr(attributeKey) which will return value; then resolve.

Test childNode out of bounds throws IndexOutOfBoundsException.

Test sibling navigation when no parent returns empty list.

Test replaceWith with null argument throws IllegalArgumentException.

Now produce test file.

We'll need imports: org.junit.Test, org.junit.Before, static org.junit.Assert.*; also need org.jsoup.nodes.*; maybe need java.util.*.

Implement TestNode subclass inside test file.

Let's write the test class.

Will include markers ###Test START## and ###Test END##.

Now produce final answer.
